notes.title: ❗ Leaderboard Removed (Temporary)
notes.notes:
[p]Hi everyone,[/p][p]I’ve pushed an update today that [b]removes the leaderboard system entirely[/b]. The reason is simple: it was broken in a way that stopped new players from even being able to start the game. With the current very small player base, keeping a broken system up just doesn’t make sense.[/p][p]That said, I want to make this clear:
➡️ If several players genuinely want the leaderboard back, I’ll prioritise fixing and re-implementing it in the future.[/p][p]For now, removing it ensures that everyone who buys or tries [i]Shape Warzone[/i] can actually play without issues.[/p][p]Thanks for your understanding and if you’d like to see the leaderboard return, please let me know in the Community Hub or the discord server.[/p][p]– Pavel[/p]

notes.title: ⚠️ Leaderboard Bug – Fix in Progress
notes.notes:
[p]Hi everyone,
It’s come to my attention that the leaderboard system is currently broken, which means new players can’t set a name and start playing. I’m really sorry for the frustration this causes. I tested it the day before launch end everything worked perfectly..[/p][p]I’m already working on a fix, and I’ll push an update as soon as possible so you can get into the game without issues.[/p][p]Thank you for your patience. I’ll keep you updated, and I’ll post again as soon as the fix is live.[/p][p]– Pavel[/p]

notes.title: 🟢 📣 Shape Warzone is now live!
notes.notes: [p]Hey everyone! After 1.5 years of solo development, my first game [b]Shape Warzone[/b] is finally out on Steam![/p][p]It’s a [b]no-path tower defense[/b] game where enemies attack from all directions. You’ll build your base, survive unpredictable waves, face off against boss fights with unique mechanics, and when things get overwhelming… you can unleash the [b]Quantum Decimator[/b].[/p][p]This game was made entirely on my own, and while it’s simple, it’s complete and I’m proud of it. If you enjoy strategy, base-building, or wave survival gameplay, you might find something here you like.[/p][p]👉 [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3402850/Shape_Warzone/"]Play it now on Steam[/url][/p][p]Thanks to everyone who supported this journey. If you play it and enjoy it, leaving a review or sharing it means a lot. It really helps small games like this get noticed.[/p][p]– Pavel[/p]

notes.title: Final Testing Phase – Release Incoming!
notes.notes: [p]Hi gamers! I have been working on finishing up Shape Warzone and I think I have quite a good build now! I will have a couple people test this version for any bugs or balancing issues, and once that is done and complete, I will [b]finally release this game![/b] [/p][p][/p][p]If you have played the game before, I wanna let you know; I have [b]updated the game massively[/b] since the last time I have announced something. I have added many new features, quality of life improvements and also new buildings, levels, a tutorial, and all sorts of things! The game has come quite far in the 1.5 years I have developed it and I can say that I am proud of my achievement here! Having a fully working game like this, built entirely by myself, still feels kind of surreal.[/p][p][/p][p]If you’re interested in the game, want to help test, share ideas, or follow my future projects, feel free to join our Discord community![/p][p]Thanks for the support! The release of Shape Warzone is coming soon(ish)! :D[/p]
